```{r}
#| label: setup
#| output: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
# Load the project's functions from the checkout (decision 0042) and read the
# published data bundle, so this code reproduces the figure (decision 0040).
root <- Sys.getenv("CFB2NFL_ROOT")
if (!nzchar(root)) root <- pkgload::pkg_path()
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = root)
pkgload::load_all(root, quiet = TRUE)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggiraph)

con <- DBI::dbConnect(
  duckdb::duckdb(),
  file.path(root, "data", "cfb2nfl.duckdb"),
  read_only = TRUE
)
release <- data_release_date()
ps <- collect(tbl(con, "ps_change"))
DBI::dbDisconnect(con, shutdown = TRUE)
# The current college season is still being played, so its partial stat lines
# are left out of the shares (decision 0053 and the card rules).
through <- last_complete_cfb_season()
ev <- transfer_events(ps) |>
  filter(season <= through)
```

```{r}
#| label: figure
# Each old tier's transfers split by the new tier, so every row sums to 100%.
# The Group of Five row's two moves are outlined: down to FCS and up to Power.
tier_moves <- ev |>
  filter(!is.na(from_tier), !is.na(to_tier)) |>
  count(from_tier, to_tier, name = "moves") |>
  group_by(from_tier) |>
  mutate(row_share = moves / sum(moves)) |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(
    from_tier = factor(from_tier, rev(transfer_tier_levels())),
    to_tier = factor(to_tier, transfer_tier_levels()),
    direction = case_when(
      as.integer(to_tier) > as.integer(from_tier) ~ "up",
      as.integer(to_tier) < as.integer(from_tier) ~ "down",
      TRUE ~ "same"
    ),
    text_colour = if_else(row_share > 0.5, "white", "#111827"),
    tip = sprintf(
      "From %s to %s: %s transfers, %.0f%% of those leaving %s",
      from_tier,
      to_tier,
      formatC(moves, big.mark = ",", format = "d"),
      100 * row_share,
      from_tier
    )
  )
outlined <- filter(
  tier_moves,
  from_tier == "Group of Five",
  to_tier %in% c("FCS and below", "Power")
)

p <- ggplot(tier_moves, aes(to_tier, from_tier)) +
  geom_tile_interactive(
    aes(fill = row_share, tooltip = tip, data_id = paste(from_tier, to_tier)),
    colour = "white",
    linewidth = 2
  ) +
  geom_tile(data = outlined, fill = NA, colour = "#111827", linewidth = 1.6) +
  geom_text(
    aes(
      label = sprintf("%.0f%%\n(%s)", 100 * row_share, formatC(moves, big.mark = ",", format = "d")),
      colour = text_colour
    ),
    size = 4.4,
    fontface = "bold",
    lineheight = 0.9
  ) +
  scale_colour_identity() +
  scale_x_discrete(
    labels = c("FCS and below" = "FCS\nand below", "Group of Five" = "Group\nof Five", "Power" = "Power")
  ) +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "#F3F4F6", high = "#374151", limits = c(0, 1), guide = "none") +
  labs(
    title = "Where each tier's transfers went",
    subtitle = "Share of each old tier's transfers by new tier",
    x = "New tier",
    y = "Old tier",
    caption = card_caption(release)
  ) +
  theme_card() +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank())

card_thumbnail(p, "transfer-tier-moves", release = release)
card_interactive(p)
```

```{r}
#| label: origin-by-season
# Each old tier's direction mix season by season, from 2016 when transfers
# are counted well enough to split.
origin_season <- ev |>
  filter(season >= 2016, !is.na(from_tier)) |>
  mutate(
    move = case_when(
      direction == "To a higher tier" ~ "up",
      direction == "Same tier" ~ "same",
      TRUE ~ "down"
    )
  ) |>
  count(season, from_tier, move, name = "moves") |>
  group_by(season, from_tier) |>
  mutate(origin_share = moves / sum(moves)) |>
  ungroup()

p_origin <- ggplot(
  origin_season,
  aes(season, 100 * origin_share, colour = move)
) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point_interactive(
    aes(
      data_id = paste(from_tier, move),
      tooltip = sprintf(
        "Leaving %s, %d: %.0f%% %s (%s transfers)",
        from_tier,
        season,
        100 * origin_share,
        move,
        formatC(moves, big.mark = ",", format = "d")
      )
    ),
    size = 2.2
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~from_tier, nrow = 1) +
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = c(up = "#1D4ED8", same = "#374151", down = "#9CA3AF"),
    labels = c(up = "To a higher tier", same = "Same tier", down = "To a lower tier")
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = unique(c(2016, 2021, through))) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 100)) +
  labs(
    title = "Each old tier's direction mix by season",
    subtitle = "Share of transfers leaving each tier, by direction",
    x = "Season",
    y = "Share of that tier's transfers (%)",
    colour = NULL,
    caption = "Hover a point for the season's count. Direction is measured between competition tiers, not programs, so a move between two Power schools is same tier."
  ) +
  theme_card()
card_interactive(p_origin)
```
